sources.entry: PB for Desktop - Receive native push notifications on macOS, Windows and Linux.

summary.one_liner: PB for Desktop is an unofficial, lightweight open-source desktop app that shows native push notifications from PushBullet on macOS, Windows and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs in the menubar (macOS) or system tray (Windows) and displays PushBullet pushes as native notifications using macOS Notification Center, the Windows 10 Action Center, or libnotify on Linux. For text pushes it generates thumbnails from the originating website's favicon, and for image pushes it shows a thumbnail-sized image. Notification sounds can be the default PushBullet sound, one of several bundled sets, or a custom .m4a, .mp3, .mp4, .ogg or .wav file. A portable file-based filter, which supports regular expressions, can skip unwanted notifications. The README also lists SMS send and receive for Android devices, inline SMS reply on macOS, and Android notification mirroring. It is not affiliated with PushBullet, Inc.
use_cases: Get PushBullet notifications on a desktop computer
Receive phone alerts in macOS Notification Center
Send and receive SMS from a desktop via PushBullet
Filter out unwanted push notifications with regex
Reply to SMS directly from a macOS notification
Customize notification sounds for desktop alerts
how_to_run: Download the latest version from the release link in the README (Standard Installation)
git clone the repository, then cd pb-for-desktop
npm run start (development mode; add --debug for dev tools)
stack: Electron (implied by Spectron e2e reference; not explicitly named)
wine, mono, fakeroot, dpkg (build prerequisites for cross-platform packaging)
notable: Native notifications on all three platforms, with favicon-based thumbnails for text pushes
Portable file-based notification filter that supports regular expressions
Ships several notification sound sets plus custom sound file support
Can build for other platforms from macOS using wine, mono and fakeroot
caveats: Cross-platform builds need extra tools (wine, mono, fakeroot, dpkg) and macOS is needed to build all platforms
Roadmap lists binaries not yet signed for distribution (macOS, Windows) and end-to-end tests still to come
Tested only on macOS Mojave, Windows 10 builds 1607-1803, and Ubuntu 19 and elementaryOS 0.4
